entities.summary: Asifa Akhtar is a Germany-based biologist born in Pakistan, who has made significant contributions to the field of epigenetics, particularly chromatin regulation. She is Senior Group Leader and Director of the Department of Chromatin Regulation at the Max Planck Institute of Immunobiology and Epigenetics and Vice President of the Max Planck Society. Akhtar was awarded EMBO membership in 2013, membership in the German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina in 2019, and the Royal Society foreign membership in 2025.
